title: Man dies in custody
article: Seven city police officers are being investigated by Ontario's civilian police watchdog after a man died in custody late Thursday night.
The incident began at about 11:20 p.m. when police responded to a break and enter, the Special Investigations Unit said Friday.
While police were investigating the break-in they tried to arrest Peter Lamonday, 33, at a nearby variety store, but a fight broke out between Lamonday and the officers, the SIU said.
The officers had difficulty arresting Lamonday and called for backup. Lamonday was eventually arrested and taken to hospital, where he went into medical distress and died, the SIU said.
